content.comment_body: I'm using [product_name] [version_no] software on my computer. When I try to download or upload a program to the [product_name], it takes about 5 minutes for the software to detect the device. After it's recognized, the download speed is normal. My USB port is assigned to COM 17. Could this be causing the issue? I'm using an HP Compaq 6720s running Windows XP Professional.
Hello, try setting the virtual COM port for your USB cable to a lower number. While I'm not certain this will resolve the problem, it's my best suggestion.

Hi everyone with slow [product_name] communications! The USB-to-COM port driver often struggles when many virtual COM ports have already been created by Windows, especially if Bluetooth is active on your PC—these drivers typically add several virtual COM ports. If you install the [product_name] USB cable after that, it may get assigned a high COM port number (such as 17), causing [product_name] [version_no] to take a long time to detect and communicate with the device. The best approach is to uninstall your Bluetooth devices and drivers (sometimes you need to disable Bluetooth in BIOS or use a hardware switch), remove the [product_name] USB cable driver, restart your PC, and install the [product_name] USB cable driver first to ensure it gets a lower COM port number (preferably below COM 5). Afterwards, you can reinstall your Bluetooth devices, so those virtual COM ports are assigned higher numbers, keeping the [product_name] USB port assignment low and making communications faster. Hope this helps!

analysis.insight_summary: Users experience long delays—about five minutes—when [product_name] [version_no] software tries to recognize a connected [product_name] device via USB, with the actual program transfer working at normal speed once connection is established. The main challenge is the initial recognition, which is significantly affected by high virtual COM port numbers assigned due to several Bluetooth or other device drivers installed in Windows.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] devices to be detected quickly and reliably by [product_name] [version_no] software over USB, without delays resulting from system COM port assignments.
